title: Decision Bonus for Renewing Within the Opt-Out Window: Small Business Electricity Supply Loyalty Credit
content:
**Decision bonus.** On the renewal loyalty credit of a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, when a final options notice is on record and the acceptance is dated no later than that notice's date plus the plan's opt-out window days, 15.00 dollars are added; when no final options notice is on record, 25.00 dollars are added; when the acceptance is dated after the opt-out window closed, nothing is added.

The plan's opt-out window is 15 calendar days on every Small Business Electricity Supply plan. The acceptance date is the renewal election date on the agreement record; the notice date is that of the final options notice on the agreement, the latest by notice date where more than one is on record.

| Final options notice on record | Acceptance dated | Decision bonus |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no later than the notice date plus 15 days | 15.00 USD |
| yes | after the notice date plus 15 days | none |
| no | any date | 25.00 USD |

**Boundary (hypothetical final options notice dated 1 December)**

| Acceptance dated | Decision bonus |
|---|---|
| 20 November | 15.00 USD |
| 16 December | 15.00 USD |
| 17 December | none |
